title: Guide
summary: How to set up and use the tool.
body:
Start with the card `guide/setup` and then read the card `guide/usage`.
Run it with the example `run` or see the example `settings` of the card `guide` for the settings file.
The limits are described in the card `reference/limits`, and
the thing lives in another library.
A code span such as `[[x]]` is not a link.
Version 2.5 of simple accepts at most 42 items.
